description: Per-play ledger for scout card calls (tier 2/3 of the daily card policy in MLBstrikeouts/CLAUDE.md). Model plays are NOT logged here - fade-ml/props/hand-tails keep their own files. No-play days are logged too: an empty card is part of the record. Prices are the card-time quote, not the close.
pre_log_note: Daily totals supplied by the user on 2026-08-24 for the days before per-play logging began on 2026-08-21. The card-grade-totals subset of these days went 3-1 per CLAUDE.md (2026-08-20).
